findings.title: Only accept leading help flags
findings.text: Scanning every argument makes a value like `--help` or `-h` (for `--provider-cmd`, `--baseline`, `compare`, etc.) be treated as a help request, so the command silently exits 0 instead of running. The documented form is `<command> --help`, so only the first argument should be recognized.

findings.title: Keep init root usage error
findings.text: This early exit lets `req init --root <dir> --help` (or `req --root <dir> init --help`) answer 0 and silently ignore `cli_root`, despite the documented rule that `--root` on `init` is a usage error (exit 2). Guard the help answer on `cli_root.is_none()` so `init::run` still reports the usage error.
